items.name: build-your-own-x
items.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
items.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

items.name: everything-claude-code
items.summary: Everything-Claude-Code是一个专为AI编程助手设计的性能优化框架，旨在提升如Claude Code等工具在代码生成中的效率和稳定性。它采用研究优先的开发理念，通过技能、直觉、记忆和安全四大核心模块，使AI助手能够更智能地理解上下文并保持一致性。开发者可将其集成到现有工作流中，探索高级智能体功能，优化AI编程体验，或基于其模块化架构构建针对特定编程场景的定制化扩展。
items.summary_en: Everything-Claude-Code is an agent harness performance optimization system that enhances AI coding assistants like Claude Code by improving their efficiency and reliability. It employs a research-first approach with specialized modules for skills, instincts, memory, and security, enabling more consistent and context-aware code generation. Developers can integrate it into their workflows to experiment with advanced agent capabilities, optimize existing AI coding tools, or build custom extensions for specific programming tasks.

items.name: get-shit-done
items.summary: Get-shit-done 是一个基于 JavaScript 的元提示系统，旨在通过结构化 Claude Code 的交互来生成更可靠的 AI 代码。其核心能力是上下文工程——将提示、规范和示例组织成可复用的模板，从而引导 AI 产生一致的输出。开发者可以用它来定义编码标准、根据规范生成样板代码，或为特定领域（如 API 开发或数据处理）构建自定义的提示工作流。该系统通过规范驱动的开发方法，将模糊的需求转化为清晰的指令，适合需要可预测性和可维护性的 AI 辅助编程场景。
items.summary_en: Get-shit-done is a JavaScript-based meta-prompting system that helps developers create more reliable AI-generated code by structuring Claude Code interactions. Its core innovation is context engineering—organizing prompts, specifications, and examples into reusable templates that guide AI toward consistent outputs. Developers can use it to define coding standards, generate boilerplate from specs, or build custom prompt workflows for specific domains like API development or data processing.

items.name: Maestro
items.summary: Maestro是一款开源端到端测试框架，专为移动和Web应用自动化设计，通过简化配置和脚本编写降低测试门槛。其核心创新在于采用基于YAML的声明式语法，允许将用户操作定义为简单动作序列，使测试用例更易读写和维护。开发者可快速为Android、iOS和Web平台编写测试，集成到持续交付流程中，并利用可视化录制功能捕捉真实交互进行自动化验证，适合需要高效回归测试和跨平台兼容性检查的团队。
items.summary_en: Maestro is an open-source end-to-end testing framework that simplifies mobile and web app automation by eliminating complex setup and scripting. Its key innovation is a YAML-based declarative syntax that allows testers to define user flows as simple sequences of actions, making tests more readable and maintainable than traditional code-heavy approaches. Developers can quickly write tests for Android, iOS, and web platforms, integrate them into CI/CD pipelines, and use its visual test recorder to capture real user interactions for automated validation.

items.name: arnis
items.summary: Arnis 是一款开源工具，能够将真实世界的地理数据转换为高度精细的《我的世界》游戏地图，实现数字世界与现实地点的无缝对接。它通过调用 OpenStreetMap 和 Overpass API 提取地图信息，并利用 Rust 语言的高效性能将道路、建筑等地物精准转化为游戏方块。用户可基于其模块化设计自定义地形生成规则，用于创建教育可视化项目、开发定制游戏场景，或探索程序化世界生成的技术思路。
items.summary_en: Arnis is an open-source tool that transforms real-world geographic data into detailed Minecraft worlds, bridging digital recreation with actual locations. It leverages OpenStreetMap and Overpass API to extract and convert map features into Minecraft blocks with impressive accuracy. Developers can use its Rust-based architecture to customize terrain generation, experiment with procedural world-building, or integrate it into educational projects that visualize real places in a game environment.

items.name: opendataloader-pdf
items.summary: OpenDataLoader-PDF 是一款基于 Java 的开源 PDF 解析工具，可将复杂 PDF 文档转换为 JSON、HTML 等结构化、AI 可读的数据格式。它结合 OCR 识别与边界框检测技术，在准确提取文本的同时保留文档布局和可访问性元素，输出结果既适合机器处理也便于人工理解。该工具可集成至数据预处理流程，自动化支持信息检索、合规检查或为 AI 模型提供训练数据，适用于需高效文档解析的研究与应用场景。
items.summary_en: OpenDataLoader-PDF is a Java-based PDF parser that transforms complex documents into structured, AI-ready data formats like JSON and HTML, addressing the challenge of extracting meaningful information from PDFs for machine learning applications. Its technical strength lies in combining OCR recognition with bounding-box detection to preserve document layout and accessibility features, making parsed content both machine-readable and human-friendly. Developers can integrate it into data pipelines to automate document processing for tasks like information retrieval, accessibility compliance, or training custom AI models on textual data.

items.name: gte-small
items.summary: GTE-Small 是一个紧凑的多语言文本嵌入模型，能够将不同语言的句子转换为语义丰富的向量表示，用于跨语言相似度计算。它基于 BERT 架构，通过知识蒸馏技术压缩模型规模，在保持高精度的同时大幅减少计算资源需求。开发者可通过 Hugging Face 快速部署，适用于多语言搜索引擎、文档聚类、智能推荐等场景，尤其适合资源受限环境或需要支持上百种语言的实用项目。
items.summary_en: GTE-Small is a compact multilingual text embedding model that converts sentences into meaningful numerical vectors for semantic similarity tasks. It uses a BERT-based architecture optimized through knowledge distillation, achieving strong performance while being 5x smaller than typical models. Developers can easily integrate it via Hugging Face Transformers for applications like multilingual search, content recommendation, or clustering across 100+ languages with minimal computational overhead.

items.name: Qwen3.5-9B
items.summary: Qwen3.5-9B是一个拥有90亿参数的多模态语言模型，能够同时处理文本和图像输入并生成连贯的文本输出，解决了传统模型在跨模态理解上的局限性。其技术亮点在于采用了高效的架构设计，在保持强大性能的同时降低了计算资源需求，使得多模态AI更易于实际应用。开发者可通过Hugging Face平台获取该模型，针对视觉问答、图文内容生成或智能对话等场景进行微调和部署，为构建更智能的交互系统提供了实用工具。
items.summary_en: Qwen3.5-9B is a 9-billion-parameter multimodal language model that excels at understanding and generating text from both textual and visual inputs, bridging the gap between different data modalities. Its technical strength lies in its efficient architecture that balances performance with computational feasibility, making advanced multimodal AI more accessible. Developers can fine-tune it for specific applications like visual question answering, content generation from images, or enhanced conversational agents, leveraging its open-source availability on Hugging Face for experimentation and deployment.

items.name: bert-base-uncased
items.summary: BERT-base-uncased是一种双向语言理解模型，通过同时分析上下文捕捉完整语义，克服了传统单向模型的局限。其核心技术为掩码语言建模，训练时随机遮盖词汇并预测内容，从而学习深层语言规律。该模型可通过Hugging Face库加载，支持微调实现文本分类或问答功能，也可直接提取词向量用于语义相似度计算，为自然语言处理提供基础能力。

items.name: electra-base-discriminator
